propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time, wasting all post-edit billing and invalidating Pass-1 fingerprint-keyed checkpoints.
The cancel predicate must be scoped to own material only (not relation snapshot or tracker HEAD) to avoid reintroducing the d70a regression of false cancels on unrelated ticket writes.

The cancel signal must be an out-of-band token checked before recovery paths in produce_plan_review_verdict, not a step failure, because step failures trigger coach/verify recovery reconstruction and sidecar emission.

Probes are placed at exactly two between-pass seams (after finders, after decide) and perform lightweight single-ticket reads under local_read_context with no fetch/reconverge or sync-lock acquisition.
A cancelled review returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding before any signing or sidecar emission, and the CLI maps it to exit 2.
